tabs.title: Weight room
tabs.intro: Use these when a station's equipment is taken by another pod, broken, or missing. Phase 1 and 2 swaps also apply to the barbell lifts in Phases 3-4.

groups.heading: Main lifts
groups.note: Check with your coach first. A different implement changes the load, so the percentage of your max doesn't carry over: pick a found weight (hard, form holds, 2-3 reps in reserve) and do the week's sets and reps.

rows.swap: Goblet Squat or Front Squat, dumbbells racked at the shoulders
Trap Bar Deadlift, or Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift if no bar at all
Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
Dumbbell Bench Press

Dumbbell Overhead Press - since this station is normally tied to a tested OHP e1RM, treat this one session as found-weight instead (pick a weight for the week's prescribed sets and reps - 3x5, or 3x4 in Weeks 5 and 9 - with 2-3 reps in reserve) rather than trying to convert the percentage

Band-Assisted Pull-up if the bar's occupied but full reps still fit the moment; for added weight with no belt/vest available, hold a dumbbell between the feet or wear a loaded backpack. If the pull-up bar area itself is unavailable: Inverted Row, using a barbell racked at hip height in a squat rack - body underneath, chest to bar - same pulling pattern, different setup
Push-ups, same rep count
Dumbbell Row or Band Row
Bodyweight Calf Raise, paused at the top
Band Overhead Press
Goblet Squat or Walking Lunge
Suitcase Carry (one dumbbell, walk a set distance each side) - not identical, but hits the same anti-rotation demand
Bodyweight Squat, paused at the bottom
Cable Row (if the machine's free) or Band Row
Reverse Crunch on the floor
Bodyweight single-leg RDL
Bottom bleacher step, or any stable platform roughly 12-18 inches
Band Woodchopper, band anchored to a rack
Hop Series
Any small marker - water bottle, shoe, folded towel
Dumbbell Jump Squat (hold dumbbells at the sides) or Kettlebell Jump Squat - same triple-extension pattern, no trap bar needed
Dumbbell Jump Shrug (hold dumbbells at the sides, same hip-hinge-to-shrug pattern) or Kettlebell Jump Shrug - no trap bar needed

rows.primary: Landmine attachment (or a barbell wedged in a corner)
rows.swap: Single-arm Medicine Ball Rotational Throw against a wall - same rotational power pattern
Landmine Rotational Press if a landmine setup exists; band-resisted rotational throw (anchor a band at chest height) if neither is available

rows.primary: Partner to hold ankles, or a Nordic bench/GHD
rows.swap: Anchor feet under a loaded barbell in a rack, or under the bottom of a squat rack's safety pins - same eccentric hamstring pattern

tabs.title: Field
tabs.intro: Use these when field or conditioning equipment is unavailable.

rows.primary: Sled (Phase 3 uses 2 units; none in the Retest Week)
rows.swap: Partner-resisted sprints (a training partner holds a resistance band/harness from behind) or, if no sled or band is available, unresisted sprints at the same distances. Do not substitute a weighted vest to approximate these %BW sled loads - a vest is not a safe stand-in at these loads.

rows.primary: Stopwatch (two for split timing in Phase 3, including the Retest Week)
rows.swap: Single-timer protocol: time the full 20m only (3 attempts, best time) and group athletes on that measured 20m time; the 10m split is not recorded and is not estimated. Use the same protocol for that athlete at the Retest Week, so a 20m-only time is never compared with a split time. In Phase 4 (In-Season) any phone or watch stopwatch is fine: no squad-wide split-timed testing.
Any flat, safe grass or turf field surface, with distances measured and marked by cones or field paint.
Cone-only pattern drills covering the same footwork sequence.

rows.item: Ice machine for the hydration station
rows.swap: Coolers with bagged ice and cups. Water-break frequency and the heat-day protocol stay the same regardless of ice source.
A cleared, flat section of weight-room floor with bumper plates works if a dedicated platform isn't available.
Any phone or watch timer. It is needed for the session-load (sRPE) calculation, not for testing.
